name: com.yohash.propulsion
description: Physics-based controllers for Rigidbody propulsion. StablePdController matches a target position or rotation (1 or 3 axes) with a physically parameterized response (frequency in Hz, damping ratio) that is unconditionally stable at any timestep. PidController provides a bounded throttle with an integral term. Includes a vehicle motor and AI follower, with comparison samples.

samples.description: Compares a PID controller with the Stable PD controller, with and without target-velocity tracking, moving a Rigidbody2D along one axis to match a target's position.
Compares a 3-axis PID controller with the Stable PD controller, with and without target-velocity tracking, moving a Rigidbody under gravity to match a target's position.
Compares a PID controller with the Stable PD controller, physically rotating a Rigidbody2D turret to point at a target.
Uses the Stable PD controller, with and without target angular-velocity tracking, to physically rotate a turret to point at a target while keeping it upright.
Drives a physics-based car with the keyboard (WASD) through the VehicleMotor.
Uses the VehiclePdController as an AI that matches the trajectory of a user-controlled (WASD) vehicle.
